habits.name: Plan the day
habits.definition: Choose your most important task and write a simple plan.

habits.name: Read or learn
habits.definition: Spend a little time learning something useful or interesting. Choose your own duration.

habits.name: Move your body
habits.definition: Choose movement that suits your day, such as walking, stretching or a workout.

habits.name: Hydration check-in
habits.definition: Pause to check your thirst and keep water within reach. Set a personal target if you want one.

habits.name: Focused work or study
habits.definition: Finish one distraction-free session on something that matters to you.

habits.name: Connect with someone
habits.definition: Make time for a meaningful conversation or shared activity.

habits.name: Personal care
habits.definition: Complete a self-care routine that suits you.

habits.name: Evening wind-down
habits.definition: Set aside a little time to unwind and prepare for rest.
